name: Carma
long_description:
Carma is building an AI-native platform that transforms fleet operations from tedious, manual work into effortless, automated workflows.

We’re the fastest-growing company in fleet management software. Carma already powers some of the largest fleets in the U.S., including Fortune 500 clients, saving operations teams thousands of hours by eliminating busywork and keeping vehicles on the road.

Backed by Soma Capital, Y Combinator, founders of Superhuman, and Tier-1 investors, we raised our $5.5M seed and are sprinting toward a Series A in 2026.

We’re hiring the top 0.1% of engineers who want real ownership and impact—starting Day 1, you’ll build and ship fast to production for enterprise clients. Fleet operations run in real time, so your work is immediately used in the field and gets real customer feedback in hours, not months.
one_liner: The AI Operating System For Modern Fleets.

launches.title: Carma: We replaced fleet operations with software.
launches.tagline: AI that runs fleet ops end-to-end, unlocking revenue and curbing costs.
launches.body:
**We manage 10,000+ vehicles for Fortune 500 companies with a team of 10.**

8 months ago, we scrapped our original model and rebuilt Carma as an AI-native operating system for fleet operations.

Since then, every metric has compounded.

⸻

**The problem**

Fleet maintenance is the #1 cost for companies that run vehicles.

And it’s still managed with:

* 15+ disconnected tools
* spreadsheets
* phone calls

Million-dollar decisions happen daily.

Made by people who:

* aren’t automotive experts
* aren’t incentivized on cost

So they approve everything.

Management can’t keep up. The problem requires deep technical context. It gets ignored.

As fleets grow, complexity snowballs.

The double-effect is vicious:

Vehicle uptime drops while costs spiral.

Margins bleed heavily.

⸻

**Why incumbents fail**

The incumbent software providers are 30+ year-old leasing companies.

They make money when fleets replace vehicles more often.

So real optimization works against them.

Their software reflects it:

* system of record
* not system of intelligence

_In reality:_ glorified Google Drive with manual data entry.

No automation. No decisions. No leverage.

⸻

**What we built**

Carma replaces the entire stack.

Our AI system, Neo, runs fleet operations end-to-end:

* automates all repetitive daily workflows
* replaces all manual labor
* replaces all fragmented software

And makes optimal decisions:

* verifies pricing
* selects vendors
* schedules maintenance
* audits invoices
* determines replacement timing

Not when a leasing company wants to sell a new vehicle.

When it actually makes economic sense.

Every service makes Neo smarter.

Customers don’t add Carma.

They replace everything with it.

⸻

**Traction**

* +10,100+ vehicles in 8 months, growing \~35%+ MoM
* 13 enterprise customers (all $100M+ revenue, including F500 clients)
* 100% customer retention
* $2,500+ value per vehicle annually
* 7.6x average cash ROI for customers

⸻

**Why now**

AI can finally automate judgment, not just data entry.

_Before:_ hire more people or accept inefficiency.

_Now:_ neither.

⸻

**Team**

Built to win this market:

* CEO: $60B+ M&A in automotive & fleet
* Chief Growth Officer: Scaled a medical practice portfolio from $5M to $31M while in med school
* CTO: ML infra at Google Cloud, real-time systems at Discord
* Head of Ops: ASE Master Tech, built ALLDATA international ops

⸻

**If you’re an investor or operator in this space, email us:**

[muhammad@joincarma.com](mailto:muhammad@joincarma.com) - Muhammad Alasgarli, Founder and CEO

[suleyman@joincarma.com](mailto:suleyman@joincarma.com) - Suleyman Alasgarli, Founder and Chief Growth Officer

launches.title: 🚗Carma – Fleets get top service centers to bid for same-day service
launches.tagline: Never overpay or wait weeks for quality vehicle service ever again.
launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=76596&key=user_uploads/1377569/6e469c63-fd73-4b07-a14c-c16389064f61)

**tl;dr:** Carma saves fleets generates measurable P&L savings on the order of hundreds of thousands to millions of dollars on vehicle repairs and maintenance with same-day service – Carma clients get pushed to the front of the line and don’t have to wait weeks to get vehicles back on the road!

**💰Referral Opportunity:** We’re offering $100 in cash for every vehicle onboarded through a warm referral to a new client. 500 vehicles = $50,000 cash referral bonus. In addition, the referred fleet receives a 25% discount on their Carma subscription fees for their first 12 months.

**🤝 [Join Carma Now](https://www.joincarma.com/)**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=76596&key=user_uploads/1377569/ff0b49ed-15b5-4336-89fb-fef7553f940a)

We are also hiring top-caliber full-stack software engineers and account executives – apply [**HERE**](https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/carma/jobs) today.

**👀 [See How Carma Works](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Hx7fTYv3GBw)**

**😡The Problem: Fleets HATE getting vehicle repair!**

It’s a time-draining hassle to get vehicle repair for fleets – a lack of price transparency makes U.S. fleets lose $37 billion each year due to improper or unnecessary vehicle repairs. Based on recent industry statistics, service centers overcharge fleets 85% of the time, leaving fleets overpaying an average of 68% more than what they actually should based on the fair cost of service. The worst part: there’s not much the average fleet management team can do – most fleets rely on minimal spares and don’t have the time to price shop for quotes. 80% of fleet managers don’t know what fair auto repair pricing looks like for non-routine repairs.

**💲The Solution: Carma**

Carma gets fleets prioritized same-day service offers with guaranteed, locked-in pricing. Fleet managers request any service they need through Carma, which we send to our highly rated and vetted local service center Partner Centers, who respond with real-time offers. Fleet can compare multiple same-day service offers in just 60 seconds or less. Carma handles the transaction with zero fees – no marked-up prices or “convenience” charges – you pay the service center’s in-store price or better.

Fleets save upwards of 50% when they use Carma vs. the median price for the same service in their zip code. It takes just 30 seconds to add a car to your profile and request service.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=76596&key=user_uploads/1377569/179a2ad1-4d43-4195-8951-dcba9afe1f1c)

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦**Meet the TEAM**

We are setting a new standard in automotive service to make pricing transparent and the entire process hassle-free.

Carma was founded by a team of automotive experts with deep technical domain expertise from the most prominent industry leaders, with a combined 120+ years of experience in the automotive service industry:

* [**Muhammad Alasgarli**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/muhammadalasgarli/) **- Co-Founder & CEO.** Previously, Muhammad worked in investment banking (M&A/Restructuring) in NYC where he executed mega-cap mergers & acquisitions for publicly traded auto-tech companies, automotive OEMs, Tier 1 suppliers, and related auto service providers. He has worked on over $60B of cumulative transactions for notable corporate clients such as Carvana, Honeywell Transportation Systems, and various stakeholder affiliates of Hertz Rent-A-Car. Graduate of Washington University in St. Louis.
* [**Suleyman Alasgarli**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/suleyman-alasgarli-6a54b1147/) **- Co-Founder & Head of Revenue.** Prior to joining Carma, Suleyman led operations for a portfolio of commercial and residential real estate investments and served as Operations Director for a prominent dental care chain, where he managed the entire sales pipeline end-to-end. Suleyman studied biology and chemistry with an emphasis in biomedical science at the University of Missouri - Kansas City.
* **Alan Kennedy - Vice President of Sales.** Alan spent 36 years at Hunter Engineering Company, most recently as an International Regional Manager for the Asia-Pacific region and previously as a U.S. sales representative for Hunter Engineering’s sales territories in Texas and Oklahoma, specializing in undercar service equipment sales to independent automotive service centers and dealerships, with extensive experience in direct sales to both single-location and large-chain service facilities.
* [**Doug Felt**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/doug-felt-63a30911/) **- Technical Product Manager and Subject Matter Expert.** Prior to joining Carma, Doug spent 46 years in automotive service: 32 years at Hunter Engineering Company as a Technical Training Manager and Subject Matter Expert, where he managed a portion of Hunter Engineering's training department supplying training to automotive and heavy truck technicians using over 35 satellite training centers nationally; including wheel alignment, balancing, tire changing, brake lathe operation, and counter sales training. Doug also managed training partnerships with Audi/Volkswagen, Bridgestone, Goodyear and a variety of other industry leaders. Before this, Doug spent 7 years as a Shop Manager at Hood’s Automotive and 7 years as a service technician and instructor in the U.S. Air Force.

**💰Our Offer to You**

Our sales process is supercharged by personal introductions, so any fleets whose owners or operational managers who you know or could introduce us to would be **very valuable**.

If you have a relationship with the C-Suite, owner, operations executive, or anyone else at business that owns cars – anything from HVAC, plumbing, pest control, landscaping, construction, cleaning & restoration, electrical contracting, sanitation, etc. – please give us a three-way intro over text or email (Muhammad, **636.293.5254 or** [**muhammad@joincarma.com**](mailto:muhammad@joincarma.com)):

For each vehicle onboarded through your warm referral to a new fleet client, we will wire you $100 in cash. 500 vehicles = $50,000 cash referral bonus. In addition, your referred fleet receives a 25% discount on their Carma subscription fees for their first 12 months.

**🙋Open Letter to Fleets**

Dear fleets, please give us your feedback if you think anything can be improved in our user interface or user experience so we can deliver the most fluid customer journey possible. No forms, just call or text me (Muhammad, CEO) on my cell and give me direct feedback: (**636.293.5254**). You can also email your feedback to me at [**muhammad@joincarma.com**](mailto:muhammad@joincarma.com) – I read and respond to every user.

**🤝 [Join Carma Now](https://www.joincarma.com/)**

**👀 [See How Carma Works](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Hx7fTYv3GBw)**

**Cities where Carma is live now: St. Louis, MO; Kansas City, KC; Oklahoma City, OK; Springfield, MO; Nashville, TN; Dallas, TX; Houston, TX; and Phoenix, AZ.**
